title: Playback, Layering & Mixer Engine
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main 54482405620eaf136a79d99a4ccb7edf609bcfaa and application main d6b6f4c9316e01f55611e256924b67eaf5f4b3da, re-reading the AAI program/backlog, AAI-04 selection checkpoint, completed AAI-01 provider/API/license evidence, AAI-02 canonical audio schema and AAI-03 adapter/capability-negotiation framework, then resolving the bounded provider-neutral playback/layering/mixer, rights/capability-gating, persistence and validation contract before implementation branch creation.
objective: Define and prove a provider-neutral playback, soundscape-layer and mixer state engine over completed AAI-02 audio identities and AAI-03 evidence-driven capability negotiation. The engine fails closed unless the relevant AAI-02 right is explicitly allowed and the required AAI-03 capability is usable (or, for user-owned local files, an explicit runtime media probe is supported); it preserves manual/external, silent, unavailable and degraded nonblocking outcomes, deterministic layer ordering/mix state and receipts, and all gameplay-owner boundaries. It does not perform semantic audio resolution, implement provider-specific live adapters, authenticate to providers, acquire provider content, record/stream, scrape, pay, release or deploy.

execution.rule: AAI-04 is a provider-neutral runtime state/command engine. It may produce deterministic local-media or adapter-control command descriptors and in-memory playback/mixer state, but AAI-06 remains owner of provider-specific live transports/adapters. Manual external paths remain manual and no provider-specific workaround is synthesized.

gating.rights_rule: Every audible asset requires AAI-02 play rights exactly allowed. denied, unknown and not-applicable fail closed. Capability never overrides rights.
gating.capability_rule: Provider/external controlled playback consumes AAI-03 playback-control, one-shot-control or mix-volume-control negotiation as applicable. Only AAI-03 selectable outcomes may yield controlled/manual execution; unsupported, undocumented, unknown, planned and provider-contact-required outcomes remain unavailable.
gating.local_rule: User-owned local playback additionally requires AAI-03 local-file-access to be usable and an explicit AAI-04 runtime media probe state supported. The probe is per execution input and does not rewrite or infer AAI-01/03 capability evidence.
gating.manual_rule: AAI-03 manual-external-reference produces AAI-04 manual-external, never an automated provider call.

cue_and_reference.rule: AAI-04 may follow only AAI-02 explicit asset IDs, soundscape layer asset IDs, or manual-reference cue asset/source references. unresolved cues remain degraded/nonblocking and silent cues remain silent. No tag/intent/provider matching or semantic asset selection is performed.

layering_and_mix.ordering_rule: Soundscape layers execute in ascending authored order with stable layerId as deterministic tie-break.
layering_and_mix.group_rule: A layer asset kind maps only to the existing AAI-02 mix groups music, ambience or one-shot. Missing groups use gain 1 and muted false without inventing a new group.
layering_and_mix.gain_rule: Effective gain is deterministic layer gain multiplied by matching mix-group gain; muted is true when either the layer or matching mix group is muted. Inputs remain in the AAI-02 validated 0..1 gain domain.
layering_and_mix.failure_rule: Silent, missing, denied or unsupported layers never block gameplay or other eligible layers; each layer receives an explicit receipt outcome.

receipts.rule: Receipts contain stable request/soundscape/layer/asset/source/adapter IDs, rights state, AAI-03 negotiation outcome, runtime probe state when relevant, effective gain/mute state, execution outcome and provider-neutral command descriptor. Wall clock, machine path, credentials, live provider responses and network state are excluded.

identity_and_owners.rule: AAI-02 provider/source/asset/reference/intent/cue/soundscape/mix identities are consumed, never rewritten. World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners remain canonical; playback state is presentation/support state only and cannot create gameplay truth.

persistence.result: No durable runtime persistence is required for AAI-04. Playback/layer/mixer state and deterministic receipts are ephemeral or caller-owned runtime values derived from canonical inputs; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

validation_contract.focused: Prove independent fail-closed rights/capability gates, explicit local runtime probe handling, manual-external/silent/unavailable/degraded outcomes, no semantic resolution, deterministic layer ordering/gain/mute state and receipts, AAI-02/03 identity preservation, no provider-specific calls/content acquisition and owner nonmutation.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-03, AAI-02 and AAI-01 verifiers plus MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-04 in canonical Repository Health path coverage and self-hosted Validation Core discovery without introducing provider/network dependencies.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head passed Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-04 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared AAI-03/02/01/World-owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..04 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-02 rights evidence and AAI-03 capability evidence remain independent and fail closed; capability never grants a denied or unknown right
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/reference/intent/cue/soundscape/mix identities remain binding inputs and cannot be rewritten
user-owned local playback requires explicit runtime probe evidence and does not rewrite AAI-01/03 evidence
unresolved, silent, manual, unavailable and degraded audio remain nonblocking outcomes
manual external references remain manual; unsupported operations cannot be emulated by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited copying
AAI-05 is selected_not_started only; AAI-06 provider-specific live adapters remain unauthorized
no provider authentication/live catalog/provider calls/acquisition/download/copying/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
next_action: Closed. AAI-04 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. AAI-05 may be selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads and governed-start AAI-05 before semantic taxonomy or availability-resolver implementation begins.
